stats.note: Reference 168 has zero cause/effect (eitza or cause-type) edges in torahData.js. Torah #168 is a two-sentence aphorism whose causal structure (pride signals destruction, humility signals honor) was identified during bechina package analysis but no corresponding edges exist in the dataset. The four nodes in the existing packages (גאוה, גדלות, ענוה, שפלות) are all bechina-cluster nodes. The eitza-destination concepts (שבר, צרה, כבוד) noted in the packages file's eitza_summary do not appear as edges in the dataset and therefore produce no nodes requiring assignment.
